cohort: All individuals delivering at designated Maternal Obstetric Units and hospitals in Blantyre, Malawi; Johannesburg, South Africa; Kampala, Uganda; and Chitungwiza and Harare, Zimbabwe, or admitted for postpartum care within seven days of delivery elsewhere, were included in the review.
finding: The study found background rates of 13% for preterm birth, 4.1% for stillbirth, 4.4% for gestational hypertension, 15.5% for low birthweight, 2.0% for neonatal death, and 1.2% for suspected congenital anomalies across the four sites.
